coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 12 of 17 ground-truth items (71%): Adam/MSE with early stopping, consistent data splits, all six model-configuration variables, both data-processing variables, and MSE/MAE metrics. Visualization requirements are only partially covered.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies CPU-only execution rather than a single 24GB RTX 4090, 100–200 epochs rather than 30, and batch sizes 32–64 rather than 256. Synthetic-data generation parameters are absent. Training-loss curves are included, but learned cyclic-pattern plots are missing. The loss ablation also departs from the fixed-MSE control.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion describing a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting or visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
